text: BAM share rose 1.12 percentage points over 23 hours, to 33.9% of all Solana stake routed through BAM, broadly matching the 1.11 percentage point gain over 7 days. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 22.1% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The top node changed hands 63 times this window, consistent with whale-driven routing rather than broad validator churn.
